description: We are a group of students and a teacher from At Home School of English. We are interested in putting our team of young minds into action to approach challenges.
summary: Our "Mars Survival guide" is a web app where you can visualize a 2D/3D rendering of the Jezero Crater. It consists of a scientifically pertinent map and a gamified approach to learning about Mars.
details:
Our "Mars Survival guide" is an attempt to gather every pertinent available piece of information regarding the Jezero Crater, Mars. It consists of a web app where you can visualize a 2D/3D rendering of the Crater itself, with measurements and visual representations of important data (elevation from the Mars 2020 CTX DEM, thermal inertia from THEMIS, the USGS geologic map, CRISM mineralogy, a climate model fitted to Perseverance’s MEDA data, and live moon positions from JPL Horizons) layered over it. Every piece of information is connected to the respective source of data. The intention is to provide an easily avialable tool for enthusiasts and experts alike.

In addition, a "Story Mode" has been created as an alternate approach to the act of learning about the Crater and Mars itself. It is an attempt to foster interest and facilitate learning through a gamified approach, appealing to the innate human proclivity to learn through storytelling. To do this, a set of characters has been created, with clear profiles and uniquqe interactions with the player. This story takes place in a 1x1 rendering of Jezero where you have to roam the barren land using a Mars Rover inspired by Perseverance. The route making and pathing uses real data, points of interest are based on real CRISM mineralogy research. By tying this raw information to a captivating story we attempt to make factual data meaningful and significant.

To achieve our goal we made use of Anthropic's Claude, used mainly in coding, but also in some of the research. The goal was to make it as lightweight and readily available as possible. 3D rendering was purposefully done with the use of three.js to harness WEBGL and make it runnable in every web browser.
